questions.text: Do you already have a grinder?
options: Yes, but shots jump between settings

questions.text: How do you want to grind?

options: I can spend more for stepless adjustment

keep.title: Keep your grinder
keep.text: It works. Put your effort into puck prep and the adjacent-setting test above before spending anything.

pro.title: Baratza Encore ESP Pro
pro.text: Stepless adjustment, plus hopper or single-dose and a timer. It’s the best match for a machine where the grind is your only dial.

esp.title: Baratza Encore ESP
esp.text: A fine pick at this budget, especially if you’ll use the dual-wall basket. Steps are coarser, so expect less fine-tuning.

df.title: A DF54 single-dose grinder
df.text: Built for single-dosing and bean swaps. More hands-on per shot, and it’s mainly an espresso grinder. Check the version and burr option before ordering.
